description: Defines the mbinfo class for reading system monitoring data from CSV logs, including methods for temperature, fans, and voltage readings.

classes.name: mbinfo
classes.description: A class for parsing MBM5 CSV logs to retrieve system temperature, fan, and voltage data.

methods.name: temperature
methods.description: Reads temperature data from MBM5.csv and returns an array of temperature readings with labels, values, limits, and percentages.

methods.name: fans
methods.description: Reads fan speed data from MBM5.csv and returns an array of fan readings with labels, values, minimums, and divisions.

methods.name: voltage
methods.description: Reads voltage data from MBM5.csv and returns an array of voltage readings with labels, values, minimums, and maximums.
